gloss: to sink to; to stoop to; to degrade oneself to

definitions.gloss: to sink to; to stoop to; to degrade oneself to
definitions.explanation: to fall to a lower status, role, or condition that is considered shameful

examples.japanese: {詐欺師|さぎし}に{成|な}り{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: He sank to becoming a con artist.

examples.japanese: {犯罪者|はんざいしゃ}に{成|な}り{下|さ}がるとは{思|おも}わなかった。
examples.english: I never thought he would stoop to becoming a criminal.

examples.japanese: かつての{英雄|えいゆう}が{乞食|こじき}に{成|な}り{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The former hero was reduced to begging.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})

USAGE:
- 〜に{成|な}り{下|さ}がる (to sink to becoming ~)

NUANCE:
Strongly negative connotation. Implies a shameful fall from a better state. The destination is always something considered degrading or dishonorable.

CONTRAST:
- {成|な}り{上|あ}がる (to rise in status - opposite direction, but also often negative as "parvenu")
- {落|お}ちぶれる (to come down in the world - similar but less focused on moral degradation)
